title: 第1005章 赤红铠甲第1004章 朝廷的奖赏
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
晚上。
九黎圣地，心宗藏经阁内。
景无心满意地看着方正丹田之内的阴阳二气。
如今阴阳二气已经炼成，剩下的就是观想法相了。
可惜这一点还是需要依靠方正自己完成。
虽然他也能强行介入，让方正能够速成法相。
但法相境不比真丹、化灵。
更加注重修炼者本身对法相的感悟。
这也关系到方正未来能够走多远。
要是太过干预，导致方正未来潜力受损，那可就不好了。
毕竟将来他是要夺舍方正的。
影响了方正的潜力，就是了影响他的潜力。
念及至此，景无心也是念头一动，解除了对方正的操控。
一脱离修炼状态。
方正就猛地睁开双眼！
充满愤怒的目光瞬间锁定了站在他面前的景无心。
“老不死的！”
下一瞬。
一道残影划过水面，方正催动全身气血跟真气，一拳轰向景无心，势要将景无心一拳打死！
砰！

一道沉闷的声音响起。
方正只感觉胸口被一块巨锤击中了一般，体内气血跟真气瞬间被打散了。
五脏六腑也瞬间爆裂开来！
一口鲜血喷涌而出。
方正整个人的身体倒飞出去，扑通一声坠入湖泊之内。
“你如果想杀我，就好好努力，说不定能在我夺舍你的时候，为你自己多增添几分胜算。”
景无心给方正画着饼，声音在此方天地之间传播。
面对他的夺舍，方正有胜算吗？
心铠加上唯心真界经，或许有稍许胜算。
只是这点胜算可以忽略不计。
毕竟两人之间的实力差距太过悬殊，再加上他还是唯心真界经的开创者。
对唯心真界经的了解远超于方正。
实力、功法、时间。
三者没一点站在方正那边。
content_en:
night.
Jiuli Holy Land, inside the Xinzong Sutra Pavilion.
Jing Wuxin looked at the yin and yang in Fangzheng's dantian with satisfaction.
Now that the two qi of yin and yang have been refined, all that is left is to observe the phenomena.
Unfortunately, this still needs to be done by Fang Zheng himself.
Although he can also forcefully intervene, allowing Fang Zheng to quickly achieve the Dharma.
But the realm of Dharma is not as good as the real elixir or spirit transformation.
Pay more attention to the practitioner's own understanding of the Dharma.
This is also related to how far Founder can go in the future.
It would be bad if there was too much interference that would damage Founder's future potential.
After all, he will seize Fangzheng in the future.
The potential that affects Fang Zheng is the potential that affects him.
Thinking of this, Jing Wuxin also had a thought and released Fang Zheng's control.
Once out of the cultivation state.
Fang Zheng suddenly opened his eyes!
His angry eyes instantly locked onto Jing Wuxin who was standing in front of him.
"Immortal old man!"
The next moment.
An afterimage streaked across the water. Fang Zheng mobilized all his blood and energy and punched Jing Wuxin, threatening to kill Jing Wuxin with one punch!
Bang!
A dull voice sounded.
Fang Zheng felt as if his chest had been hit by a giant hammer, and the blood and energy in his body were instantly dispersed.
The internal organs also exploded instantly!
A mouthful of blood spurted out.
Fang Zheng's whole body flew backwards and fell into the lake with a splash.
"If you want to kill me, then work hard. Maybe you can increase your chances of winning when I take your body."
Jing Wuxin drew a cake for Fang Zheng, and the sound spread between heaven and earth.
Faced with his desire to seize the body, does Fang Zheng have any chance of winning?
With the Heart Armor and the Heart-Only Realm Sutra, there might be a slight chance of winning.
But this chance of winning can be ignored.
After all, the gap in strength between the two is too huge, and he is also the founder of the Weixin Realm Sutra.
His understanding of the Weixin Realm Sutra far exceeds that of Fang Zheng.
Strength, skills, time.
The three of them are not on Fang Zheng's side at all.
